Voice memo at 5:00pm: It’s been a tough week with delays and feedback issues. We really need solutions to fix this—urgently!

Aisha (Marketing, Campaigns): “Most of today went into orchestrating the upcoming product launch campaign that’s scheduled for the 18th. I finalized the email sequences for new and existing users, making sure the messaging for each segment highlights the right benefits—new users get a ‘this solves your problem X’ narrative, while existing users see ‘here’s what’s new and why it matters’. I synced with the social media team to align on the launch-day content calendar and confirmed that our paid ads will go live within a 2-hour window of the in-app announcement. I also worked with the design team to iterate on the hero illustrations, ensuring they render well on both mobile and large desktop screens. I’m currently blocked on getting final product screenshots and a short demo GIF from the engineering team; without those, the blog post and landing page will feel abstract. My intent tomorrow is to lock the blog draft, submit all creatives to legal for a quick review, and prepare a monitoring dashboard for key launch metrics (CTR, signups, feature adoption) so we can react quickly in the first 72 hours after release.”

Tanvi (UX Researcher): “Most of my day was spent synthesizing insights from last week’s diary study and mapping them to the roadmap. I finished transcribing and coding all participant entries, tagging themes like ‘collaboration friction’, ‘notification overload’, and ‘fear of messing things up’ when editing shared documents. I then created a journey map that highlights the emotional highs and lows in the first 30 days of using our product, which I’ll present in tomorrow’s design crit. I also met with the Product and Customer Success leads to validate whether the patterns I’m seeing align with what they’re hearing in the field. We discovered a gap around how admins onboard new team members; they often send a single welcome email and assume everything else will self-organize, which leads to inconsistent usage. I’m blocked on getting historical usage data segmented by role and tenure, which would help quantify some of these findings; I’ve requested this from Data. My intent tomorrow is to finalize a concise research readout, propose 3–4 concrete opportunities for improving onboarding and collaboration, and align with Product on which of these should feed into the Q3 roadmap.”
